runtime_configuration.setup_script:
same_snapshot_process() {
    [ -r "/proc/$target_pid/stat" ] || return 1
    process_stat=$(cat "/proc/$target_pid/stat") || return 1
    process_fields=${process_stat##*) }
    set -- $process_fields
    [ "$#" -ge 20 ] || return 1
    process_state=$1
    shift 19
    [ "$1" = "$expected_start" ] && [ "$process_state" != Z ]
}
stop_snapshot_process() {
    if same_snapshot_process; then
        kill -TERM "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then kill -KILL "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then
            echo "Snapshot process did not exit: $target_pid" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}
for pid_record in /run/snapshot-bench-*/controller.pid /run/snapshot-bench-*/bench-fc.pid; do
    [ -f "$pid_record" ] || continue
    read target_pid expected_start < "$pid_record"
    case "$target_pid:$expected_start" in *[!0-9:]*|:|*:) continue ;; esac
    [ "$target_pid" -gt 1 ] || continue
    stop_snapshot_process
done
if [ -f /run/firecracker.pid ]; then
    target_pid=$(cat /run/firecracker.pid)
    case "$target_pid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) target_pid=0 ;; esac
    if [ "$target_pid" -gt 1 ] && [ -r "/proc/$target_pid/cmdline" ]; then
        process_command=$(tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$target_pid/cmdline")
        case "$process_command" in '/lab/firecracker --no-api --config-file /run/firecracker.json '*)
            process_stat=$(cat "/proc/$target_pid/stat")
            process_fields=${process_stat##*) }
            set -- $process_fields
            shift 19
            expected_start=$1
            stop_snapshot_process
            ;;
        esac
    fi
fi

for mod in kvm_intel kvm; do attempt=0; while [ -d /sys/module/$mod ]; do if rmmod $mod; then break; fi; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); [ $attempt -lt 50 ] || exit 1; sleep .1; done; done
insmod /modules/kvm.ko nx_huge_pages=never enable_pmu=0
insmod /modules/kvm-intel.ko pml=0 enable_apicv=0 flexpriority=0 preemption_timer=0
echo 1 > /sys/kernel/rcu_expedited

same_snapshot_process() {
    [ -r "/proc/$target_pid/stat" ] || return 1
    process_stat=$(cat "/proc/$target_pid/stat") || return 1
    process_fields=${process_stat##*) }
    set -- $process_fields
    [ "$#" -ge 20 ] || return 1
    process_state=$1
    shift 19
    [ "$1" = "$expected_start" ] && [ "$process_state" != Z ]
}
stop_snapshot_process() {
    if same_snapshot_process; then
        kill -TERM "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then kill -KILL "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then
            echo "Snapshot process did not exit: $target_pid" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}
for pid_record in /run/snapshot-bench-*/controller.pid /run/snapshot-bench-*/bench-fc.pid; do
    [ -f "$pid_record" ] || continue
    read target_pid expected_start < "$pid_record"
    case "$target_pid:$expected_start" in *[!0-9:]*|:|*:) continue ;; esac
    [ "$target_pid" -gt 1 ] || continue
    stop_snapshot_process
done
if [ -f /run/firecracker.pid ]; then
    target_pid=$(cat /run/firecracker.pid)
    case "$target_pid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) target_pid=0 ;; esac
    if [ "$target_pid" -gt 1 ] && [ -r "/proc/$target_pid/cmdline" ]; then
        process_command=$(tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$target_pid/cmdline")
        case "$process_command" in '/lab/firecracker --no-api --config-file /run/firecracker.json '*)

            process_fields=${process_stat##*) }
            set -- $process_fields
            shift 19
            expected_start=$1
            stop_snapshot_process
            ;;
        esac
    fi
fi

    [ -r "/proc/$target_pid/stat" ] || return 1
    process_stat=$(cat "/proc/$target_pid/stat") || return 1
    process_fields=${process_stat##*) }
    set -- $process_fields
    [ "$#" -ge 20 ] || return 1
    process_state=$1
    shift 19
    [ "$1" = "$expected_start" ] && [ "$process_state" != Z ]
}
stop_snapshot_process() {
    if same_snapshot_process; then
        kill -TERM "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then kill -KILL "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
        attempt=0
        while same_snapshot_process && [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
            sleep .02
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        done
        if same_snapshot_process; then
            echo "Snapshot process did not exit: $target_pid" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}
for pid_record in /run/snapshot-bench-*/controller.pid /run/snapshot-bench-*/bench-fc.pid; do

    case "$target_pid:$expected_start" in *[!0-9:]*|:|*:) continue ;; esac
    [ "$target_pid" -gt 1 ] || continue
    stop_snapshot_process
done

            set -- $process_fields
            shift 19
            expected_start=$1

            ;;
        esac
    fi
